asked.item: Must I cancel monthly subscription first when moving to yearly?

verdict.reason: S17 and S25 directly answer both questions.

steps.text: Yes, there is a yearly plan.
You do not need to cancel your monthly subscription first.

To switch, go to Settings > Billing, click View Billing Portal, click the purple Update subscription button next to your current plan, select the yearly option for the plan you want, and confirm the change.
